title: GAP-09: only the ACMP BINDING record persists; AECP state, names and maps have no NVM manager
body:
[A10] Found by the compliance-matrix audit of `docs/00_MILAN_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW.md` at main 6a878f6 (owner request, 2026-09-18). The matrix Cov column grades the ORIGINAL architecture document; this ticket records what the tree carries today. Baseline at that head: `./scripts/run_suites.sh` exit 0 (30 of 30 suites, 14790 checks), `./scripts/lint_hdl.sh` exit 0.

## Finding

GAP-09 (Major), F00.2 verdict of this audit: **PARTIAL**.

- Resolution claimed in F00.2: NVM manager, records, commit/restore flows
- "Addressed in" check: {'ok': True, 'note': "docs/architecture/07_memory_maps.md:329-392 (section 5): persisted-vs-volatile table 5.1 (:333-336), F07.8 record framing with record structs RATE, FMT_IN/OUT, PT_OFS, BINDING, MAPS_IN/OUT, CLKSRC, NAMES, CFG_IDX, SUID, MCR (:340-358), F07.9 commit + boot-restore-before-entity_enable + PRB_W_AVAIL preload flows (:365-385). The doc describes a multi-record NVM manager; the RTL banner says that manager 'lands in P4' (hdl/acmp/KL_acmp_nvm_shadow.sv:13-15)."}
- "Verified by" claimed: NVM
- In `hdl/` today: Persisted today (commit AND restore): bound state + binding params + started/stopped only - hdl/acmp/KL_acmp_nvm_shadow.sv (BINDING[i] record {valid,started,sw,talker_uid,talker_eid,ctlr_eid}, F07.8 framing + crc16, debounce, bounded retry + alarm, two-phase restore then pre_* replay; banner :11-44), instantiated hdl/top/protocol_processor_top.sv:2330 feeding KL_pp_nvm_port :2370 (hdl/packet_engine/KL_pp_nvm_port.sv), preload into the listener via pre_valid/pre_started :1723-1729/:2345-2351, device face :417-431, restore pins :405-414. NOT persisted (mark only, no manager, no replay): the microcode raises NVM_MARK for sampling rate (hdl/aecp/ucode/gen_ucode.py:468,:1315), clock source (:1372), configuration index (:1608), audio mappings (:1724), stream format (:1858), presentation offset via SET_STREAM_INFO (:1935) and names (:2024), but the strobe and mark are left unconnected at the top (hdl/top/protocol_processor_top.sv:2884-2885 aecp_eff_nvm_stb_nc_w/aecp_eff_nvm_mark_nc_w, :3164-3165); KL_aecp_dyn_state only raises dirty_o (hdl/aecp/KL_aecp_dyn_state.sv:66-68,:123,:292) which leaves the chip as aecp_dyn_dirty_o (hdl/top/protocol_processor_top.sv:606,:3199) with no restore/write-back port into the overlay. Per group: sampling rate NO; stream formats in/out NO; presentation offset NO; bound state+binding params YES; started/stopped YES (in BINDING flags); input mappings NO and output mappings NO (stores are the integrator's, mark 6 unconnected); clock source NO; user names NO (on-chip name overlay, mark 7 unconnected, no replay); configuration index NO; SUID/MCR NO. Restore-before-enable is NOT enforced in RTL: restore_done_o is consumed only at :2338 and the side-port status read :3961; ordering is an integrator step (docs/guides/integrator.md:275-281). A restored binding does start in PRB_W_AVAIL (listener pre_* face).
- In `tb/` today: NVM category, partly real: tb/acmp_nvm/sim_main.cpp F0-F18 boot replay incl. 'F10 listener wrote three PRB_W_AVAIL records' (:604) and F14 discovery armed (:614), per-record crc/version/length defaults that never abort, G torn mid-record read-back aborts the whole restore, change-during-restore/flush (76 checks, README mutation record M1-M6); tb/nvm_port (122 checks) commit/restore envelopes, fixed-point power cuts T17/T18, refusals, completion ownership. Shortfalls recorded by the suite itself: tb/nvm_port/README.md:440-447 - four *REQ arms uncovered and 'this suite uses fixed cut points on both sides, so the randomized half is still owed' against 09_verification.md:56. tb/pp_top only checks 'R: restore_done' (sim_main.cpp:7808-7813). Persisted-set completeness per REQ-PER-001 and 'every record type cut >= once' cannot be graded: BINDING is the only record type that exists. No suite grades REQ-PER-002 volatility across a reset at top level, REQ-AEM-013 clock-source persistence or REQ-PER-003 config index. Open issues on these suites: #15 (no timeout: silent device wedges the port), #17 (MAX_PAYLOAD_P unenforced), #18 (power-cut suite never asserts rst_n), #19 (four nvm_port mechanisms with zero coverage), #20 (dying flash classified blank), #21 (no handshake-misbehaving device model).

## What remains

Implementation: the multi-record NVM manager of 07 section 5 does not exist; only the ACMP BINDING group (bound state, binding params, started) is committed and restored. Owed: commit + boot-replay for RATE, FMT_IN/OUT, PT_OFS, CLKSRC, CFG_IDX, NAMES (and MAPS_IN/OUT, SUID, MCR), i.e. consume eff_nvm_stb/eff_nvm_mark (currently _nc_w) and add a restore write path into KL_aecp_dyn_state and the name overlay before entity enable; decide whether mappings are persisted here or by the integrator and say so in 07 5.1. GAP-08/GAP-09 bodies and REQ-AEM-011/-021 already say names replay and mapping persistence remain open (parent kebag-logic/milan-fpga#70; no issue in THIS repo owns it). Restore-before-entity_enable is an integrator rule, not an RTL interlock. Verification: randomized cut points, the four uncovered *REQ error arms, a real rst_n power cut (#18), every-record-type cuts and REQ-PER-001 completeness are all owed; related open issues #15 #17 #18 #19 #20 #21 each own one nvm-suite defect, none owns the whole gap.

## Acceptance

1. eff_nvm_stb_o/eff_nvm_mark_o are consumed by a manager that commits RATE, FMT_IN/OUT[i], PT_OFS[i], CLKSRC[d], CFG_IDX and NAMES[n] records in F07.8 framing through KL_pp_nvm_port, and boot restore replays them into KL_aecp_dyn_state and the name overlay before the entity may be enabled (or 07 5.1 explicitly assigns each group to the integrator)
2. A suite sets each persisted field over AECP, power-cycles (rst_n) and reads the same value back with GET_* while LOCK, registry and IDENTIFY read their reset defaults (REQ-PER-001/-002/-003, REQ-AEM-013)
3. The NVM suite cuts every record type at seeded-random commit points, including a real rst_n cut, and shows crc fallback to the per-record default with restored bindings entering PRB_W_AVAIL
4. GAP-08/GAP-09 body text and the REQ-AEM-011/-021 Finding cells stop pointing at an open item once replay lands
